name: Seat Probe (research)
description: Research for Koleda's FRV Sinner: can a mod put you straight into a vehicle seat, and where is the FRV gun's muzzle? Logs your seat whenever it changes. F5: the nearest FRV's seats (role and node per seat). Shift+F5: enter its driver seat the game's way (you play the get-in). Ctrl+F5: enter it instantly (the game's spawn-seated sequence). Alt+F5: pick the next seat index to enter instead. Insert: the FRV gun's nodes and muzzle; Shift+Insert turns one gun node (the next each press). Host or solo. Turn off when done.
